== the metalanguage bootstrap ==

== building and testing the metalanguage compilers ==
The different flavours of metalanguage compiler translate rules into different representations:

*lm2n2m: generate a compact text format (.lm/.lmr) for easy loading at run-time
*lm2n2d: wrap the text format as a D language module/program
*lmn2c: wrap the text format as a C language module/program
*lmn4d: compile to D module/program - a pattern/symbol generator is a D language function
*lmn4c: compile to C module/program - a pattern/symbol generator is a C language function

== start with a clean slate ==
In the initial state there are a number of .lmn source files and one compiled ruleset - lm2nbs.lm - the descendant of a ruleset that originally had to be constructed by hand.

  [peri@p2 lmnBootstrap]$ make clean
  rm -f *~ *.o *.lmr *.c0 *.d0 *.C *.D *.gdc *.gDc *.gcc *.gCc
  rm -f lm2n2m.ac lm2n2m.lm  lmn2c.lm lm2n2d.lm
  rm -f lm2n2m.c  lmn2c.c lm2n2d.c lmn4c.c lmn4d.c
  rm -f lm2n2m.d  lmn2c.d lm2n2d.d lmn4c.d lmn4d.d
  rm -f lmn4c.lm lmn4c
  rm -f lmn4d.lm lmn4d

  [peri@p2 lmnBootstrap]$ ls
  lmccMain.c  lm2n2cbe.lmn  lm2n2dbe.lmn  lm2n2mbe.lmn  lm2nbs.lm  Makefile
  lmddMain.d  lm2n4cbe.lmn  lm2n4dbe.lmn  lm2n2xfe.lmn  ls.txt    rub.out

== use the bootstrap to make lm2n2m.lm ==
The first thing to do is to build a compiler that compiles rules to the textual format that can be loaded at runtime by the language machine

  [peri@p2 lmnBootstrap]$ make
  ---- make lmn rule compiler using bootstrap ruleset
  lm -r lm2nbs.lm -o lm2n2m.lmr -s /usr/bin/lm lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n2mbe.lmn
  mv -f lm2n2m.lmr lm2n2m.lm
  chmod +x lm2n2m.lm

== use lm2n2m.lm to compile its own sources ==
Next we check that the compiler can compile its own sources

  ---- autocompile using bootstrapped lmn ruleset
  lm -r lm2n2m.lm -o lm2n2m.a1 -s /usr/bin/lm lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n2mbe.lmn
  cp -f lm2n2m.a1 lm2n2m.ac
  mv -f lm2n2m.a1 lm2n2m.lm
  chmod +x lm2n2m.lm

== use resulting lm2n2m.lm to compile its own sources ==
Next we check that the autocompiled compiler can still compile its own sources.

  ---- autocompile using autocompiled ruleset
  lm -r lm2n2m.lm -o lm2n2m.a2 -s /usr/bin/lm lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n2mbe.lmn
  mv -f lm2n2m.a2 lm2n2m.lm
  chmod +x lm2n2m.lm

== use resulting lm2n2m.lm to compile the other compilers ==
Initially we compile the other compilers to the internal format, sot that we can use them to compile to the wrapped and compiled forms.

  lm -r lm2n2m.lm -o lm2n2d.lmr -s /usr/bin/lm lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n2dbe.lmn
  mv -f lm2n2d.lmr lm2n2d.lm; chmod +x lm2n2d.lm

  lm -r lm2n2m.lm -o lmn4d.lmr -s /usr/bin/lm lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n4dbe.lmn
  mv -f lmn4d.lmr lmn4d.lm; chmod +x lmn4d.lm

  lm -r lm2n2m.lm -o lmn2c.lmr -s /usr/bin/lm lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n2cbe.lmn
  mv -f lmn2c.lmr lmn2c.lm; chmod +x lmn2c.lm

  lm -r lm2n2m.lm -o lmn4c.lmr -s /usr/bin/lm lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n4cbe.lmn
  mv -f lmn4c.lmr lmn4c.lm; chmod +x lmn4c.lm

== build and test compiled versions ==
  lm -r lm2n2d.lm  -o lm2n2m.d  lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n2mbe.lmn
  /opt/gdc/bin/gdc -o lm2n2m.gdc -I/usr/include -finline-functions -O3  lm2n2m.d lmddMain.d -ldl /usr/lib/liblm -Wl,-rpath,/usr/lib/
  ./lm2n2m.gdc -o lm2n2m.d0 -s /usr/bin/lm lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n2mbe.lmn
  diff lm2n2m.d0 lm2n2m.lm

  lm -r lm2n2d.lm  -o lm2n2d.d lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n2dbe.lmn
  /opt/gdc/bin/gdc -o lm2n2d.gdc -I/usr/include -finline-functions -O3  lm2n2d.d lmddMain.d -ldl /usr/lib/liblm -Wl,-rpath,/usr/lib/
  ./lm2n2d.gdc -o lm2n2d.d0 lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n2dbe.lmn
  diff lm2n2d.d0 lm2n2d.d

  lm -r lm2n2d.lm  -o lmn4d.d lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n4dbe.lmn
  /opt/gdc/bin/gdc -o lmn4d.gdc -I/usr/include -finline-functions -O3  lmn4d.d lmddMain.d -ldl /usr/lib/liblm -Wl,-rpath,/usr/lib/
  lm -r lmn4d.lm -o lmn4d.d lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n4dbe.lmn
  ./lmn4d.gdc -o lmn4d.d0 lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n4dbe.lmn
  diff lmn4d.d0 lmn4d.d

  lm -r lm2n2d.lm  -o lmn2c.d  lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n2cbe.lmn
  /opt/gdc/bin/gdc -o lmn2c.gdc -I/usr/include -finline-functions -O3  lmn2c.d lmddMain.d -ldl /usr/lib/liblm -Wl,-rpath,/usr/lib/
  ./lm2n2d.gdc -o lmn2c.d0 lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n2cbe.lmn
  diff lmn2c.d0 lmn2c.d

  lm -r lm2n2d.lm  -o lmn4c.d lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n4cbe.lmn
  /opt/gdc/bin/gdc -o lmn4c.gdc -I/usr/include -finline-functions -O3  lmn4c.d lmddMain.d -ldl /usr/lib/liblm -Wl,-rpath,/usr/lib/
  ./lm2n2d.gdc -o lmn4c.d0 lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n4cbe.lmn
  diff lmn4c.d0 lmn4c.d

  lm -r lmn2c.lm  -o lm2n2m.c lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n2mbe.lmn
  gcc -o lm2n2m.gcc  lm2n2m.c lmccMain.c -ldl /usr/lib/liblm -Wl,-rpath,/usr/lib/ -L/opt/gdc/lib/ -lgphobos -lm -lpthread -lc
  ./lm2n2m.gcc -o lm2n2m.c0 -s /usr/bin/lm lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n2mbe.lmn
  diff lm2n2m.c0 lm2n2m.lm

  lm -r lmn2c.lm  -o lm2n2d.c  lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n2dbe.lmn
  gcc -o lm2n2d.gcc  lm2n2d.c lmccMain.c -ldl /usr/lib/liblm -Wl,-rpath,/usr/lib/ -L/opt/gdc/lib/ -lgphobos -lm -lpthread -lc
  ./lm2n2d.gcc -o lm2n2d.c0 lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n2dbe.lmn
  diff lm2n2d.c0 lm2n2d.d

  lm -r lmn2c.lm  -o lmn4d.c  lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n4dbe.lmn
  gcc -o lmn4d.gcc  lmn4d.c lmccMain.c -ldl /usr/lib/liblm -Wl,-rpath,/usr/lib/ -L/opt/gdc/lib/ -lgphobos -lm -lpthread -lc
  ./lmn4d.gcc -o lmn4d.c0 lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n4dbe.lmn
  diff lmn4d.c0 lmn4d.d

  lm -r lmn2c.lm  -o lmn2c.c  lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n2cbe.lmn
  gcc -o lmn2c.gcc  lmn2c.c lmccMain.c -ldl /usr/lib/liblm -Wl,-rpath,/usr/lib/ -L/opt/gdc/lib/ -lgphobos -lm -lpthread -lc
  ./lmn2c.gcc -o lmn2c.c0 lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n2cbe.lmn
  diff lmn2c.c0 lmn2c.c

  lm -r lmn2c.lm  -o lmn4c.c  lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n4cbe.lmn
  gcc -o lmn4c.gcc  lmn4c.c lmccMain.c -ldl /usr/lib/liblm -Wl,-rpath,/usr/lib/ -L/opt/gdc/lib/ -lgphobos -lm -lpthread -lc
  lm -r lmn4c.lm -o lmn4c.c lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n4cbe.lmn
  ./lmn4c.gcc -o lmn4c.c0 lm2n2xfe.lmn lm2n4cbe.lmn
  diff lmn4c.c0 lmn4c.c

== done ==
